silkvis.screen.title: SilkVis
silkvis.footer.hint: Tab / Shift+Tab: focus · Esc: close · Right Shift: menu
silkvis.hud.editor.title: HUD editor
silkvis.hud.editor.hint: Click to select, drag to move · arrows: 1 px, Shift+arrows: 10 px · Ctrl+Z to undo · Esc to close
silkvis.map.north_up.desc: Keep the map oriented north instead of rotating with the player.
silkvis.media.enabled.desc: Reads the system media session. Playback stays in the original app.
silkvis.media.hud_widget.desc: Show the current track in the HUD.
silkvis.visual.fov.desc: Changes camera field of view only; movement and reach stay vanilla.
silkvis.theme.blur.desc: Optional effect, disabled in the Low preset.
silkvis.settings.verbose.desc: Keeps a larger bounded log. Never contains track metadata or command text.
silkvis.automation.planned_note: Automation is being rolled out goal by goal. Goals marked "Planned" have no implementation in this build and cannot be started.
silkvis.error.config_invalid: The configuration file is invalid; safe defaults were used.
silkvis.error.inventory_desync: The inventory state is out of sync.
silkvis.module.visual.camera.desc: Field of view, bobbing and camera effects.

silkvis.module.theme.local.desc: Local background image with validated limits.

silkvis.tab.music.hint: Now Playing overlay; the source is the Windows player.

silkvis.tab.automation.hint: Goals, safety limits and a stop button.

silkvis.map.title: Map
silkvis.map.hint: Drag to pan · Wheel to zoom · R — player · Right click — waypoint · Esc — close
silkvis.map.external_hint: SilkVis minimap and tile builder are off; use the Atlas map (key M by default, rebindable in Controls).
silkvis.map.external_why: With AtlasMap installed SilkVis does not build or draw its own map: one terrain pipeline, one minimap (ADR-0007).
silkvis.media.artwork.desc: Draw the cover as a coarse colour grid: there is no GPU texture path yet, so it stays blocky.

silkvis.totems.hint: Drop a picture (PNG or JPG) into the folder below and click its name: SilkVis builds a resource pack with your totem of undying.
silkvis.totems.empty: No pictures in the folder yet.
silkvis.totems.enable: The pack turns on by itself once built. These buttons are the fallback if the game did not pick it up: enable or disable it at any time.
silkvis.totems.status.ok: Done: %s. Enable «silkvis-totem» in Resource Packs; if it is already on, press F3+T.

silkvis.totems.reason.image_too_large: picture is larger than 4096 px per side
silkvis.totems.reason.write_failed: could not write the resource pack

silkvis.totems.reason.folder_full: the folder already holds 8 pictures — remove some

silkvis.totems.packresult.disabled: Pack disabled, the vanilla texture is back.
silkvis.totems.packresult.pack_not_found: pack not found: build it from a picture first
silkvis.totems.packresult.pack_apply_fai: the game refused to enable the pack — see the bug report

silkvis.soup.title: SoupVisuals modules
silkvis.soup.hint: Modules are off until you switch them on
silkvis.soup.footer: Esc or X closes. Changes apply immediately.
silkvis.soup.open.desc: Hitbubbles, TotemParticles, Hitboxes, JumpCircles, Trails, HitSounds, KillEffect, FriendsTargetRender, HandTweaks
silkvis.totems.size.desc: Edge length of the generated texture: 16, 32, 64 or 128 pixels. Larger keeps detail in the picture.
silkvis.totems.trim.desc: Removes the plain background (white, black, grey) and crops to the drawing. Works when all four corners share one colour; a photo keeps its background.
silkvis.automation.mode.off.desc: Nothing runs and nothing is pressed. This is the default.
silkvis.automation.mode.hint.desc: The plan and the status line only: no keys, no camera, no digging. Safe to leave on.
silkvis.automation.mode.move.desc: Turns the camera and presses movement keys. Never breaks or places a block.
silkvis.automation.mode.full.desc: Movement, camera and block interaction for the running goal. The server sees ordinary input.
silkvis.automation.allow_break.desc: Let a goal break blocks that are in the way. Digging is priced as the worst option.
silkvis.automation.allow_place.desc: Let a building goal place blocks. Off by default.
silkvis.automation.target_note: A goal starts on the block you are looking at, or on the block you stand on when nothing is targeted.
silkvis.automation.stop.block_changed: The world changed under the plan
silkvis.automation.stop.low_health: Health or food below the limit
silkvis.automation.stop.mode_too_low: The goal needs a higher mode
silkvis.automation.ore_mining.desc: Walks to the block you are looking at and mines it. Stops with "no suitable tool" instead of digging for minutes.
silkvis.automation.tree_farm.desc: Cuts the log cluster connected to the targeted block, highest log first, and leaves the leaves alone.
silkvis.automation.crop_farm.desc: Harvests only fully grown crops in reach and replants them right away.
silkvis.automation.navigate.desc: Walks to the block you are looking at. Goes around walls, uses doors, never digs.
silkvis.automation.pickup.desc: Walks to dropped items in range and ignores anything lying in lava or fire.
silkvis.automation.emergency_exit.desc: Leaves the immediate area when something dangerous is next to you.
silkvis.automation.auto_eat.desc: Eats safe food from the hotbar when hunger drops, instead of stopping the run. Refuses rotten flesh, spider eye, poisonous potato and pufferfish.
silkvis.automation.tool_select.desc: Holds the best tool the block needs from the hotbar before breaking it. Tier only orders tools inside one family, so an axe never wins on stone.
silkvis.baritone.missing_help: Baritone is not installed. Put the Baritone jar for 1.21.10 into your mods folder next to SilkVis, then restart. SilkVis does not bundle it.
silkvis.baritone.broken_help: Baritone is installed but its API could not be reached, which usually means a version mismatch: use a Baritone build for Minecraft 1.21.10 and the baritone-api-fabric jar, not the standalone one.
silkvis.baritone.target_note: Mine opens the ore list, Follow asks for a name, and the other three are sent straight away. Every task is off while Baritone is missing or unusable.
silkvis.baritone.menu.note: Walk here leads to the block under the crosshair, or to your feet when the crosshair points at nothing. Baritone must be installed: SilkVis only sends its commands.
silkvis.baritone.mine.help: Pick the ores, set a limit if you want one, then press Start. Baritone mines from where you stand; the limit is the number of drops it stops at, and with no limit it works until the inventory is full.
silkvis.baritone.mine.none: Pick at least one ore to start.
silkvis.baritone.follow.help: Baritone follows the player with this exact name. SilkVis does not look players up and does not guess a name.
